implementation_gate.name: stage2_grpo_pretrain_relative_dynamic_sampling
implementation_gate.scope: Replace group-centered GRPO advantages with same-live-state frozen-pretrain-relative RMS advantages, reject non-improving or zero-span candidate groups, retry at most three groups without advancing the environment, and execute one frozen-pretrain fallback after local exhaustion.

algorithm.pretrain_inference: one deterministic frozen Stage1 standard inference per live state
algorithm.acceptance_gate: max(delta) > pretrain_improvement_margin and raw reward span > minimum_raw_reward_span
algorithm.accepted_group_training: all G trajectories participate; positive and negative pretrain-relative advantages are retained
algorithm.attempt_budget: max_attempted_groups_multiplier multiplied by target accepted groups
algorithm.rejected_group_side_effects: only advance the training generator and write one sampling event; no trajectory optimization, RuleMaker finalize, optimizer update, accepted/bucket/validation progress, or env.step
algorithm.accepted_group_action: select raw reward argmax, optimize and RuleMaker-finalize it, update the policy, then advance the environment once
algorithm.exhausted_state_action: optimize and RuleMaker-finalize the cached frozen-pretrain trajectory, advance the environment once, and perform no policy update

persistence_and_invariants.sampling_event: one dynamic_sampling_attempt JSONL event per attempt with retry index, current mean/max, pretrain reward, max/mean gain, positive-delta fraction, acceptance, and rejection reason
persistence_and_invariants.loss_kl_policy_logging: one epoch-mean scalar per tag and accepted group; per-epoch JSONL retains optimizer_step
persistence_and_invariants.attempt_cap_failure: close the environment, save last checkpoint and incomplete v8 report, then raise an explicit error

legacy_checkpoint_policy.training_or_online_resume: schema1/v1 is explicitly rejected; no migration
legacy_checkpoint_policy.read_only_evaluation: an A-only explicit evaluation path accepts exact schema1/v1 or schema2/v2 identity, loads planner weights only, and never restores reference, optimizer, or optimizer step
